subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split this issue so Feishu outbound hook parity lands first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked as a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but broadening `inbound_claim` changes pre-routing claim authority and ordering for all normal channel traffic.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu/shared outbound `message_sending` coverage through the existing hook-bypass PR track and open or reuse a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

options.title: Fold into the outbound hook canonical issue
options.body: Move this issue's Feishu acceptance criteria into #92374 or #50126 and leave this item only for the inbound-claim API question.

options.title: Solve every requested hook together
options.body: Require one broader design PR for outbound parity plus normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost before the P1 outbound regression lands.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu/shared outbound `message_sending` coverage through the existing hook-bypass PR track and open or reuse a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved human choice centers on `inbound_claim` and plugin conversation-binding semantics that their plugin-surface work touched.
